values.en: Let $\gamma$ be a regular curve parametrized by arc length with $\gamma''\neq 0$, with Frenet frame $\{\mathbf{t},\mathbf{n},\mathbf{b}\}$, curvature $\kappa$ and torsion $\tau$. Then $\mathbf{t}'=\kappa\mathbf{n}$, $\mathbf{n}'=-\kappa\mathbf{t}-\tau\mathbf{b}$ and $\mathbf{b}'=\tau\mathbf{n}$; pointwise, $\mathbf{t}'(s)=\kappa(s)\mathbf{n}(s)$, $\mathbf{n}'(s)=-\kappa(s)\mathbf{t}(s)-\tau(s)\mathbf{b}(s)$ and $\mathbf{b}'(s)=\tau(s)\mathbf{n}(s)$. The derivative of every frame vector is thus again expressed in the frame itself, with a skew-symmetric coefficient matrix whose entries are $\kappa$ and $\tau$; these two scalar functions determine the frame up to a rigid motion.
values.zh-CN: 设 $\gamma$ 是满足 $\gamma''\neq 0$ 的以弧长为参数的正则曲线，其 Frenet 标架为 $\{\mathbf{t},\mathbf{n},\mathbf{b}\}$，曲率为 $\kappa$，挠率为 $\tau$。则 $\mathbf{t}'=\kappa\mathbf{n}$、$\mathbf{n}'=-\kappa\mathbf{t}-\tau\mathbf{b}$、$\mathbf{b}'=\tau\mathbf{n}$；点态地写作 $\mathbf{t}'(s)=\kappa(s)\mathbf{n}(s)$、$\mathbf{n}'(s)=-\kappa(s)\mathbf{t}(s)-\tau(s)\mathbf{b}(s)$、$\mathbf{b}'(s)=\tau(s)\mathbf{n}(s)$。于是标架向量的导数都可用标架自身线性表示，其系数矩阵是反对称的，元素恰为 $\kappa$ 与 $\tau$；这两个标量函数在刚体运动的意义下决定了标架。
